g.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Shell formed radius with template, every 150
Trough: bar Ø63.8 through both throats turns free after welding
Box face square to the bar / concentric
Inside welds: visual, ground flush, no pits or crevices; surface Ra
Shaft: Ø60 h7, Ø45 j6, keyway 14 N9, runout after welding
Stuffing box Ø80 H8 bore, Ø100 f8 spigot (gauges)
Frame: rails coplanar, bearing holes on one axis
Ribbon-to-trough gap turning by hand, full length
Passivation (ASTM A967): water break / ferroxyl test on coupons
Point-to-point wiring against E04; insulation resistance 500 V (power only)
Rotation: clockwise seen from the drive end (outer ribbons carry to the centre)
E-stop stops the agitator via STO; restart needs RESET + START
Cover open stops the agitator; closing does not restart it
Single fault on each safety channel detected (open one wire)
No-load current; full-batch current (67 kg) after 15 min
Packing run-in: weep allowed 1st hour, then re-tighten; box temp
Mixing test: 67 kg batch with 0.5 % salt tracer, 10 samples at 10 min
Discharge: residue after valve open and 60 s run
Clean-out: dry clean, allergen swab (ATP) on ribbons, boxes, valve
semi-circle R280 + 294 straight sides x 900 long
131 L = 67 kg at 0.51 kg/L (51 % of total)
ribbon blenders mix well at 40-70 % fill
typical ribbon tip 1.0-1.5 m/s for spice
Shaft shear stress Ø60 at 2 x torque
Journal shear stress Ø45 at 2 x torque
SF ≈ 3 in shear on 0.58 x yield
Key 14 x 9 x 125: shear / bearing at 2 x torque
316 key: OK; hub is the gearbox steel
Inner/outer ribbon clearance at the arms
arm of one ribbon never crosses the other ribbon
Euler buckling > 100 kN: no issue; anchors for vibration
